snippet.title: Project Rabbit - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
"JABBERWOCKY — from Through the Looking-Glass, and What Alice Found There"

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4683260/Project_Rabbit/?utm_source=novaflare_youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=project_rabbit&utm_content=trailer2

Project Rabbit is a multiplayer Soulslike action game that reimagines
Alice in Wonderland as dark fantasy. 

Step deeper into our Wonderland's dark tale and face its newest terror: the Jabberwock.

X/Twitter: https://twitter.com/NovaFlareRabbit
